question: When and how often must the prepared mantra be recited by the addressed practitioner?
premises: The recitation occurs at the beginning of japa.
The instruction is addressed to the fortunate and mature one.
The practice is to be done every day.
inference: At the beginning of recitation, the fortunate, mature one should recite the mantra every day.
plain_english: O fortunate one, O mature one, at the beginning of recitation one should recite the mantra every day.
